Question: Is it allowed to fast (nawafil) the whole year in the state of mukim and musafir except the 5 forbidden days? Answer ID: 28221 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 60/50/H=1432) The ruling of nafl sawm in journey as well as at home is the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
